Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE brand-new landscape 16:9 editorial illustration for IDC Atlas, no alternatives. Minecraft-inspired voxel industrial diorama built from crisp cubic modules, stepped silhouettes and orthogonal connections; visibly block-built three-dimensional geometry, not smooth low-poly or a pixel filter. Original industrial forms, subtle pixel-scale matte textures. Ivory studio ground and at least one-third light porcelain structures. Bright clean matte daylight, clear side faces, light shadows, vivid fresh color regions assigned coherently to systems. No neon, glow, gloss, haze, dark grading. One large focal subject at 75% frame width; central claim and focal silhouette must survive 320px thumbnail and centered square crop. Compact one dominant object and 1–3 supporting objects. NOT a literal verified site or technical diagram. Absolutely no text, titles, numbers, captions, labels, logos, flags, watermarks, people, characters, HUD, grass-block world, charts, arrows with symbols.
All object surfaces must be blank. No symbols either: no checkmarks, arrows, pictograms, horizontal faux text strokes, or signboards.
